title: Personal net worth growth assumptions
population: Broad diversified portfolio prior (exploratory, not personalized calibration)
definition: Default period return/volatility and shock priors for continuous net-worth forecasting when the user has not supplied explicit assumptions.
limitations: Not calibrated to an individual portfolio composition or tax jurisdiction.
Shock prior is a simplified drawdown event, not a full macro scenario model.
Liabilities reduce net worth only when explicitly supplied in evidence.
permitted_use: baseline continuous_target pricing and exploratory What If perturbation

claims.claim: Default return and volatility are explicit exploration assumptions, not LLM-assigned probabilities.
